# checkmk_notification_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about a CheckMK notification rule by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    checkmk = {
      source = "N3moAhead/checkmk"
    }
  }
}

provider "checkmk" {
  url      = "http://localhost:5000/test"
  username = "automation"
  password = "your-secret-here"
}

# Look up a notification rule by its UUID
data "checkmk_notification_rule" "example" {
  rule_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
}

output "notification_rule_title" {
  value = data.checkmk_notification_rule.example.title
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_id` (String) The notification rule ID to retrieve (UUID assigned by CheckMK).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the notification rule (same as rule_id).
- `rule_config` (String) The raw notification rule configuration as JSON.
- `title` (String) The notification rule title/description.
